title: Band-specific nugget optimisation for multi-band TEP prior
interpretation: The band-specific-nugget multi-band kernel BEATS the full-band kernel (median +1.69%, CI95 [+1.46, +2.48]). Per-band nuggets ({'tidal': 0.35, 'post_tidal': 0.35, 'intermediate': 0.35}) improve over the common nugget.
pre_registered_prediction: Per-band nuggets should improve over the common nugget because each frequency band has a different signal-to-noise ratio. The tidal band (gravitational, long-range) may have a lower nugget; the intermediate band (local, noisier) may need a higher nugget.
